title: llama.cpp 主线合并 DeepSeek-V4.1 flash 模型支持
summary: llama.cpp 主线落地 DeepSeek-V4.1 flash（10月25日 09:43 CST），同时为高通 Hexagon 多核 HMX flash attention 做 KV-head team 拆分。
summary_en: A quiet two-hour window on the papers-and-infrastructure beat. The only notable new signal came from llama.cpp: a commit landing DeepSeek-V4.1 flash model support (Oct 25, 09:43 CST), plus a hexagon backend change splitting KV heads across cores for multicore HMX flash attention (Oct 25, 03:19 CST). No new arXiv listings or Hugging Face daily-paper batches appeared in the window, and Phoronix/LWN had no fresh posts beyond items already collected earlier.
